routes.name: ColdPath
routes.question: Which model-loading data path minimizes held-out p95 readiness latency under changing memory, storage, and reuse context?
routes.hypothesis: Typed dependencies and measured path costs enable a safe selector to beat the best fixed deployable path.
routes.go_rule: >=10% median improvement with a 95% interval excluding zero and <=5% foreground p99 harm
routes.no_go_rule: stop if ordinary readahead explains the gain or held-out groups fail

routes.name: StateTier
routes.question: Is state identity necessary for model-state residency decisions across HBM, DRAM, and NVMe?
routes.hypothesis: Different lifecycle semantics cause action preference reversals under equal pressure.
routes.go_rule: >=10% improvement and >=50% effect retention on held-out mixes
routes.no_go_rule: stop if no action reversal exists or independent policies match the unified contract

routes.name: LoadShield
routes.question: Can model-state-aware admission protect foreground p99 under concurrent state I/O without unacceptable throughput loss?
routes.hypothesis: A measured affected-set and slack contract outperforms per-job greedy loading.
routes.go_rule: >=30% lower violation rate with >=90% useful throughput
routes.no_go_rule: stop if no reproducible affected set exists or fixed capping matches the policy
